content.comment_body: Hello, I am working on modifying a machine that uses a [product_name] controller and want to add an [product_name] HMI panel. My issue is that I can't get the views to switch automatically based on which outputs are active (for example, output Q1 displays view 1, output Q2 displays view 2, etc.). Communication between the controller and display works fine. I am using [product_name] V8.1 and [product_name] V13. Thank you for your responses.

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. The main language here is English. Since not everyone speaks French, please write your future posts in English. If needed, use online translators like Google Translate. If I understand your question: do you want the screen to switch automatically, or do you only want to show the output states?
Hello [user_name], thanks for your reply. Yes, I want the screens to change automatically.
This feature is not possible with [product_name], but it is possible with another type of controller.

I apologize, my previous statement was incorrect. I thought that changing screens was only possible with a control command, but it can also be done using a trigger variable. I have attached an example project for [product_name] HMI, a small [product_name] controller program, and a PDF file highlighting key points. In the project, make sure to adjust the IP addresses to match your devices. The connection setup is only needed in the HMI project, not in the controller program.
Here's a link to a [company_name] FAQ: How to configure screen changes via the controller in [product_name] HMI software? [url]

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion centered on setting up automatic screen changes on an HMI panel based on controller outputs. Initial feedback suggested this function was unavailable, but further clarification showed it can be done using a trigger variable in the HMI configuration tool. By applying the provided example and adjusting device settings, users achieved automatic screen changes, highlighting the value of thorough documentation and relevant sample projects.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward way to configure automatic HMI screen switches triggered by controller output states using the appropriate configuration software.
